notes.title: Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle Update Ver.1.0.0.2 Now Available
notes.content:
A patch "Ver.1.0.0.2" has been released to resolve the following issues:

Fixed a problem that prevented the game from starting up properly in some countries and regions for the Steam version of Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle.

tags.bug: Fixed a problem that prevented the game from starting up properly in some countries and regions for the Steam version of Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle.

notes.title: Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle November Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/fcf7a44c0945fa2515a1caef3bca0d1737682325.jpg[/img]

Captain Commando has heard the community’s feedback and will be implementing an update for [i]Capcom Beat ‘Em Up Bundle[/i] in November.

[b]New Screen Filters[/b] – Transport yourself back to the arcades with new scanline/arcade filter options.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/3bdd0bef36e952a4584004479b7872289456821a.jpg[/img]
Clean full res version [url=https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/strumslinger/large/53e30fd8ac580c11cb23691e150a4514.png?v=202200]here[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/82b87240da206eb1c332c3a8432a750bdbc1398a.jpg[/img]
Clean full res version [url=https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/strumslinger/large/1e5d52bd552da38dfdce2b65cae2ad44.png?v=202200]here[/url]

[b]New Screen Size[/b] – In addition to the full screen size, there is now the option to display the screen in its original size to fit more types of screens.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/ca11ffd23eb97aee69f6a3fdb489ea94e6ebf692.jpg[/img]

[b]ON/OFF Toggle for Mid-session Joining[/b] – When creating a lobby, there is now an option to turn off the ability for other players to join your in-game session.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33641209/c8a4bae79124d7f03ff0b0ba1fae036edd1b037d.jpg[/img]

Once the update is pushed in November, we’ll be sure to notify everyone via the Capcom USA Twitter and Facebook accounts.
